task.title: Bound worker commit subjects before CI
task.phase: Supervisor Delivery / Worker commit subject guard

scope.owned_layer: Shared commit subject bounding logic, worker wakeup guidance, supervisor auto-anchor fallback, worker_commit preflight check, and regression tests.
scope.not_changing: Commit trailers 72-character gate, branch protection, CI policy, merge classification, scheduler policy, or live runtime state.

failure_shapes: Wakeup guidance rendered full long TASK-ID in anchor_commit_subject template variable without bounding length.
Supervisor _anchor_commit_task_wip fallback subject formulation was not guaranteed to be <= 72 characters for long task IDs.
worker_commit wrapper did not inspect commit subject line length before staging or committing, allowing overlong subjects to reach git.
remediation: Added deterministic bound_commit_subject helper in common.py shared across watcher, supervisor, and git scripts.
Updated watch_events.py render_wakeup_message to bound anchor_commit_subject to <= 72 chars while preserving valid format.
Updated supervisor.py _anchor_commit_task_wip fallback to use bound_commit_subject.
Added preflight check in worker_commit.py rejecting message files with subject lines > 72 chars with code 5 before staging.
Added comprehensive regression tests in test_watch_events.py, test_supervisor.py, and test_worker_commit.py.

verification.command: PYTHONPATH=.orchestrator:scripts/git /tmp/pantheon-worker-worktrees/pantheon/sup-worker-subject-guard-20260811/.venv-pantheon/bin/python3 -m pytest -v .orchestrator/test_watch_events.py scripts/git/test_worker_commit.py .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py -k 'test_render_wakeup_message_bounds_anchor_commit_subject_for_long_task_id or test_anchor_commit_task_wip_bounds_subject_length_for_long_task_id or WorkerCommitPreflightTests'
